enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Unholy 7: On Hit: 7 to 42 Evil damage. Evil-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Good user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.

Revel in Blood (Slashing): Your weapon hungers to let blood flow. Your attacks and offensive spells have a high chance to deal very strong Bane damage over time to creatures vulnerable to Bleeding. On weapon crit: 16d6 Slashing Damage.
Murderous Edge: On hit: 16d6 Slashing Damage. This item is considered Metalline, bypassing all kinds of material damage resistance.
Lawful Outsider Bane 7: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt beings that judge from planar lore, dealing an additional 7d10 bane damage vs. Lawful Outsiders.
Taint of Evil: Good aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
